The NFA variants mentioned in the text are: NFA 811 (LiNi0.8Fe0.1Al0.1O2), NFA-F (LiNi0.8Fe0.15Al0.05O2), and NFA-A (LiNi0.8Fe0.05Al0.15O2).

The NFA-F variant has the highest iron content at 15%.

In the rate test, the NFA-F variant delivered a capacity of ≈81 mAh g^− 1 at 1C.
